messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:340010 rose from EUR 28.94 (po:4500010364-10) to EUR 29.89 (po:4500010407-10) between 2023-12-27 and 2024-01-05. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Your letter names firm, long-term commitments as your priority. The attached packages offer exactly that: our full annual volume, bound for 24 or 36 months, which secures your capacity planning. What is the earliest lead time you can confirm for these volumes?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. In response to your inquiry, 56 days is the earliest lead time we can confirm for this volume. 

We acknowledge the proposed volume of 23,400 units and a 24-month contract, allowing a revised price of EUR 31.50. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

Please provide the detailed should-cost estimate and forecast data you referenced. Which volume can you commit to? Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 - revised package, 23400 pcs/year over 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for confirming the price history and for your revised offer. We accept your 56-day lead time and have moved our price a clear step toward yours in the attached package.

To your volume question: we commit to 23400 pcs per year for 24 months, our full need. That is the firm, long-term commitment your letter of 18 September names as your priority, and it gives your plant a fully planned base load for two years. Our should-cost is an internal bottom-up estimate of your plant and we keep it confidential, as you do your calculation.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 - revised package, 23400 pcs/year over 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For the record:
We note your refusal to share the should-cost estimate; without verifiable data, we cannot consider it in our calculation.
We acknowledge your price increase and offer a revised price of EUR 31.40 for the 24-month commitment at 23,400 units.
This offer reflects the base load you provide while maintaining our standard conditions.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
